name: step-status
title: StepStatus
description: Workflow step outcome (Passed, Failed, Not run) and the two checks, Success criteria and Schema validation.

aria: Icon is decorative; the word carries the meaning
Not run uses a dashed outline and muted text, never reduced opacity (contrast)
Checks are a list: "Success criteria: Passed", "Schema validation: Failed"
a11y.notes: Failed steps show the attempt count: "Failed · 3 attempts".
